owner_process: Steel plates are welded together, then high-pressure forming material is pumped inside to force the blank into a shape.
process: Weld supported two-sheet blank with clamp open; park torch; clamp exposed welded flanges in open frame; pressurize through sealed hollow mandrel; retain plastic formed shape; depressurize and open frame.
provenance: new_reconstruction_from_reference; historical v0.2 native bytes unrecovered
morph: Initially flattened welded plates expand into an exposed vessel; edge flanges and round pressure-seal necks remain fixed
pending: Independent exported mechanics, pressure core and material review
Native fluid/item prototype and real pipe seating
